items.reason: P-A7-phone-watch-3-21..24 (routines built from the workouts you repeat most): kept in substance; routines come only from workout names used 3+ times, and the offer is shown only when at least one was found (import screen hides it at 0). The order by rotation and recency rather than by count is a wording nuance, not a privacy or law matter; left to lens 10. P-A7-phone-watch-3-25 ('We added the exercises from your last empty workout'): kept; the line shows only while the remembered exercises were pre-added and no set is ticked, and only exercises still on the phone are restored. No promise broken, no finding.

Notice: the opt-in photo backup sends progress photos to the member's Google backup while the notice says they never leave the phone (reused FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01); the gym's trainer measurements and diet plans kept in app storage also ride Android's own backup to Google, which the notice does not tell (reused FN-L4-phone-components-2-02). Consent: the AI finish note is opt-in behind the hidden coach switch, a member setting and a key, but the notice does not name it (reused FN-L4-phone-components-1-01). 'Ask your own AI' reads only exercises and sets, never name, phone or body weight, and only opens the share menu, as the notice says. No children-specific handling in this area.
These phone services hold no MettleUp staff access to gym data and no read log; the gym syncs only read the member's own gym answers with the member's own key.

Gym diet plans are removed from the phone on leaving the gym; the trainer's measurements are kept on the phone after leaving by design (about the member's own body) and removed by Erase all data. The notice says the gym decides about its own records and that what is on the phone stays there; no promise of a shorter keep. The remembered empty workout is replaced at each finish. The photo backup folder is deleted when the setting is turned off. No new finding.

Outside services in this area: Groq gets a fact sheet of the workout (day type, kg lifted, records, top muscles, change against last time; no name, phone or body weight) for the AI finish note, only when the hidden coach switch, the member's setting and a key are all on; the notice names Groq only for spoken feedback and spoken AI Assistant requests (reused FN-L4-phone-components-1-01, same root cause: the hidden coach sends to an AI the notice does not name). Google: the photo backup and Android's own backup (reused findings above). The CSV exports, photo save and 'Ask your own AI' only open the phone's share menu, started by the member. No analytics or Health Connect calls in these files. The Hevy link fetch lives in the other half of this folder.

On the phone, Erase all data removes the gym's measurements and diet plans, the exercise photos and videos, and the progress photo and photo backup folders; the remembered empty workout sits in the app database, which is erased with it. Its cloud copy and the server account delete are outside this area. Copies already in Android's Google backup are not reachable from the app (covered by FN-L4-phone-components-2-02 and FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01). A real erase on a phone was not run (needs a real phone).
